description: This file defines a React functional component 'SuccessToast' that displays a temporary, accessible success message banner. It manages its auto-hide timing with React hooks, applies ARIA attributes for accessibility, and debounces rapid message updates.

methods.name: SuccessToast({ message, visible, duration = Number(process.env.REACT_APP_SAVE_SUCCESS_TOAST_MS || 2000), onHide, })
methods.description: React functional component that renders a success message toast which auto-hides after a specified duration, debouncing rapid updates.
